text:
Anna Chen: quick note after testing the priority heuristics PR — when two rules have identical priority the UI currently picks an arbitrary tie-breaker. users are confused which rule wins.
Mike R: saw customer report about this. we should surface the deterministic tie-break order and let users override it.
Sophia Patel: UX idea: show a tiny badge on each rule that indicates tie-break weight (e.g., 'tie 1', 'tie 2') and a compact tooltip that explains the order algorithm :bulb:
Derek Li: also, keyboard users can't adjust tie-break via keyboard. we should allow selecting a rule and pressing Shift+Arrow to nudge it up/down within same-priority group
Jin (designbot): accessibility: announce "tie-break position X of Y" when focused and on move. ensure live region updates are polite and don't interrupt screen readers reading other content
Mike R: implementation note: backend exposes final_sort as an array of rule ids. current validation returns conflicts only. sample API:```{
  "result": "ok",
  "final_sort": ["r-10","r-11","r-12"],
  "conflicts": []
}```We can surface final_sort to show exact order in UI
Sophia Patel: simulation edgecase: when draft ties are adjusted the preview timeline flashes old results for ~300ms. feels janky. propose a short debounce + show 'Compiling draft' toast and a thin skeleton in the timeline until new results are ready
Anna Chen: agree, also add a small 'Why this rule won' expander on each sample result that lists matched clauses and tie-break reason (e.g., 'longer pattern wins', 'created earlier', 'manual priority')
Derek Li: for keyboard reorder, I'll wire Alt+Shift+Up/Down for group shuffles and Shift+Arrow for intra-group nudges. will include aria-pressed states for the nudge buttons
Mike R: i'll add the tie-break badge and tooltip. i'll also surface final_sort from the API and wire the small expander in the sample timeline
Sophia Patel: i'll write the microcopy for the tie badge tooltip and the timeline skeleton state. also will author a troubleshooting snippet: 'why my rule lost to another with same priority' for the help docs
Anna Chen: small copy ask: change the 'Preview' panel header from 'Simulation results' to 'Simulation timeline (draft)' when draft != saved. keeps mental model clear
Jin (designbot): quick a11y reminder: ensure focus moves into the expander and that collapse state is announced. add a test with NVDA + VoiceOver in the checklist
Anna Chen: plan: Mike -> tie badges + final_sort wiring + expander. Derek -> keyboard moves + aria states. Sophia -> copy + timeline skeleton + help snippet. Demo Friday 11am PT. thanks :ok_hand:
